# Unemployment Analysis

Analyze India's unemployment rate before and during the COVID-19 pandemic using data science.

## Dataset
- 768 records across 28 Indian states/regions
- Features: unemployment rate, employed count, labour participation rate
- Rural/Urban breakdown

## Analysis
- Time-series trends of unemployment
- COVID-19 impact comparison (pre vs during)
- Rural vs Urban unemployment patterns
- Regional analysis & hardest-hit areas
- Correlation between economic indicators
